Lessons.Title: Sticky Notes (optional)
ExplanationParagraphs: Learning goal: You will apply your understanding of multiplication of a whole number by a fraction to create sticky-note letter designs.
Key idea: Physical design with sticky notes requires estimates, exact measurements, and checking each dimension against the sheet.
How to reason: Select the note orientation, multiply note length by count, and verify that the resulting dimension fits available width.
